package services_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"go-net-http-auth-base/internal/domain"
	"go-net-http-auth-base/internal/mocks"
	"go-net-http-auth-base/internal/services"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/mock"
)

func TestNew{{Resources}}Service(t *testing.T) {
	repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
	service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
	assert.NotNil(t, service)
}

func Test{{Resources}}Service_GetByUUID(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("success", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		entity := &domain.{{Resource}}{UUID: "some-uuid"}
		repo.On("FindByUUID", "some-uuid").Return(entity, nil).Once()

		result, err := service.GetByUUID(context.Background(), "some-uuid")

		assert.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, entity, result)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})

	t.Run("error - not found", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		notFoundErr := domain.NewNotFoundError("{{resources}}.notFound")
		repo.On("FindByUUID", "not-found-uuid").Return(nil, notFoundErr).Once()

		result, err := service.GetByUUID(context.Background(), "not-found-uuid")

		assert.Equal(t, notFoundErr, err)
		assert.Nil(t, result)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})
}

func Test{{Resources}}Service_Create(t *testing.T) {
	dto := domain.Create{{Resource}}DTO{}

	t.Run("success", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		created := &domain.{{Resource}}{UUID: "generated-uuid"}
		repo.On("Create", mock.AnythingOfType("domain.{{Resource}}")).Return(created, nil).Once()

		entity, err := service.Create(context.Background(), dto)

		assert.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, created, entity)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})

	t.Run("error - repository fails", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		repoErr := domain.NewInternalServerError("{{resources}}.internalServerError", assert.AnError)
		repo.On("Create", mock.AnythingOfType("domain.{{Resource}}")).Return(nil, repoErr).Once()

		entity, err := service.Create(context.Background(), dto)

		assert.Equal(t, repoErr, err)
		assert.Nil(t, entity)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})
}

func Test{{Resources}}Service_Update(t *testing.T) {
	uuid := "some-uuid"
	dto := domain.{{Resource}}UpdateDTO{}
	original := &domain.{{Resource}}{UUID: uuid}

	t.Run("success", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		updated := &domain.{{Resource}}{UUID: uuid, UpdatedAt: 1}
		repo.On("FindByUUID", uuid).Return(original, nil).Once()
		repo.On("Update", *original).Return(updated, nil).Once()

		entity, err := service.Update(context.Background(), uuid, dto)

		assert.NoError(t, err)
		assert.Equal(t, updated, entity)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})

	t.Run("error - not found", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		notFoundErr := domain.NewNotFoundError("{{resources}}.notFound")
		repo.On("FindByUUID", "not-found").Return(nil, notFoundErr).Once()

		entity, err := service.Update(context.Background(), "not-found", dto)

		assert.Equal(t, notFoundErr, err)
		assert.Nil(t, entity)
		repo.AssertNotCalled(t, "Update", mock.Anything)
	})

	t.Run("error - update fails", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		repoErr := domain.NewInternalServerError("{{resources}}.internalServerError", assert.AnError)
		repo.On("FindByUUID", uuid).Return(original, nil).Once()
		repo.On("Update", *original).Return(nil, repoErr).Once()

		entity, err := service.Update(context.Background(), uuid, dto)

		assert.Equal(t, repoErr, err)
		assert.Nil(t, entity)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})
}

func Test{{Resources}}Service_Delete(t *testing.T) {
	uuid := "some-uuid"

	t.Run("success", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		repo.On("Delete", uuid).Return(nil).Once()

		err := service.Delete(context.Background(), uuid)

		assert.NoError(t, err)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})

	t.Run("error - delete fails", func(t *testing.T) {
		repo := new(mocks.{{Resources}}RepositoryMock)
		service := services.New{{Resources}}Service(repo)
		repoErr := domain.NewInternalServerError("{{resources}}.internalServerError", assert.AnError)
		repo.On("Delete", uuid).Return(repoErr).Once()

		err := service.Delete(context.Background(), uuid)

		assert.Equal(t, repoErr, err)
		repo.AssertExpectations(t)
	})
}
